name: The Devil's in the Details
source:
Due to making poor life decisions, we look forward to your employment at Imperative Solutions - Contracting Company in the Underworld!

Chat with three devilishly handsome coworkers and try to balance your job so that you can go out on Halloween Night. Are you up for the task?
